cycleTimeP95.description: The operator-declared p95 end-to-end cycle time from release into the path to manifest (ADR 0010): a declared standard, not a measured value. Required and must be positive. Encoded as a Go duration string (e.g. "2h", "90m", "2h30m").
cycleTimeP95.title: CycleTimeP95

eligibility.description: Rules a unit of work must satisfy to be routed to this path (ADR 0010). Every field is optional; an absent/empty object ({}) — or the equivalent JSON null — is the fully permissive default every path gets on migration, so today's routing behaviour is preserved exactly until an operator narrows it.

maxUnitsPerLine.description: nil/omitted means unbounded; 1 is how a singles path is declared.

requiredProductAttributes.description: Set over the fleet's existing product classification vocabulary (e.g. "hazmat", "fragile", "giftWrap"). This service does not own or validate this vocabulary.

eligibility.title: Eligibility

items.description: One source of demand that may route work onto a process path (ADR 0034). CUSTOMER_ORDER: order-management order lines. STOCK_TRANSFER: network-inventory-planning transfer legs, planned through wes-work-planning. SLOT_RELOCATION: approved slot-plan moves, planned through wes-work-planning. INVENTORY_CONTROL: internal inventory work (amnesty, damage, problem solve). REPLENISHMENT: pick-face top-ups from pick-face-replenishment, planned through wes-work-planning (ADR 0036); the only source declared on the REPLENISH path.
items.title: DemandSource

allOf.description: The set of demand sources allowed to route work onto the path (ADR 0034): routing policy, revisable like eligibility. Omitted, JSON null or [] on define is the empty set, meaning the path is reached only by an explicit path id from an upstream stage (PACK, REBIN, SLAM). An unknown or repeated value is a 422 invalid-intake.
allOf.title: Intake

intake.description: Optional on revise (ADR 0034): absent or JSON null keeps the path's current intake, so a client that predates the field never clears it; an array (the empty array included) replaces it.
